steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
ls -la
echo '---QUERY---'
cat my-sql-query.sql
echo '---SCHEMA---'
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite '.schema'
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
echo '---INDEXES---'
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"
echo '---COUNTS---'
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',count(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',count(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',count(*) FROM synsets;"
echo '---PLAN---'
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat my-sql-query.sql)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
cat > /tmp/sol.sql <<'SQL'
WITH ws AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         syn.domainid, syn.posid
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
stats AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM ws
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(cnt) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM ws
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       st.total_synsets,
       st.total_senses,
       st.distinct_domains,
       st.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM stats st
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = st.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = st.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY st.total_senses DESC,
         st.total_synsets DESC,
         st.distinct_domains DESC,
         w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL
echo '---dup wordids---'
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "select count(*)-count(distinct wordid) from words;"
echo '---run original---'
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "$(cat my-sql-query.sql)" > /tmp/orig.out
echo '---run new---'
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /tmp/sol.sql > /tmp/new.out
echo '---diff---'
diff /tmp/orig.out /tmp/new.out && echo IDENTICAL
wc -l /tmp/orig.out /tmp/new.out
EOF
